scripts.build:fable: rm -rf build && dotnet fable src/App -o build/fable
scripts.build: npm run build:fable --silent && npm run bundle --silent
scripts.format: dotnet fantomas src tests scripts/plan scripts/exchange
scripts.format:check: dotnet fantomas --check src tests scripts/plan scripts/exchange
scripts.test: npm run format:check --silent && npm run ceiling --silent && dotnet test -c Release
scripts.deploy: npm run build:rust --silent && node scripts/smoke.mjs ../dist/fabot-rs.js && npm run upload -- dist/fabot-rs.js
scripts.deploy:fable: npm run build && npm run smoke --silent && npm run upload
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
